name: Mem0
summary: Memory layer for AI agents and apps: drop-in persistent memory that lets agents learn from past interactions.
description: Graph memory is a Mem0 Platform feature (tagged [Platform] in the docs, built in with no external graph store); the pricing page lists it on Pro ($249/month) and Enterprise. The Hobby plan is free. Hosted MCP server at https://mcp.mem0.ai/mcp.
